milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the birch stairs structure (centered around spawn-relative [5, 0, 6]) and face toward it. Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the birch stairs'.
Uses inventory_has because mining a cornflower causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no cornflowers, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has to check that the player has gained emeralds from selling cod to the fisherman. The player starts with 10 emeralds; after selling 6 cod they receive 1 emerald, so having at least 11 emeralds confirms the trade was completed. This is preferred over event-based checks since the trade result is reliably reflected in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because trading for Leather Pants (internal ID: leather_leggings) places the item in the player's inventory. The player starts with no leather_leggings, so having at least 1 confirms the trade was completed successfully.
